title: EURO GOLD TOBACCO NAKED 100 60ML
description:
Euro Gold by Naked 100 is a truly creative blend by the masters at Naked 100 as part of their Tobacco line.
Unlike their American Patriots flavor, this tobacco features a much milder tone, akin to light cigarettes with a bit of added sweetness.
While tobacco is the dominant tone, your taste buds will pick up little hints of honey underpinning the smoky tobacco dusk, lightening the entire flavor profile just enough to make it accessible and delicious for vapers of all stripes.
Euro Gold Tobacco Naked 100 Features:
Mild Tobacco & Honey
